title: LatentGym: A Testbed For Cross-Task Experiential Learning With Controllable Latent Structure
abstract: arXiv:2606.15306v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We envision continually learning agentic systems that become more useful over time: as they encounter sequences of related tasks, they should infer the hidden structure shared across those tasks and use it to improve future decisions. This cross-task experiential learning capability is pivotal in domains such as personalization and interactive assistance, but existing training/evaluation frameworks do not provide shared, controllable latent structures and cannot measure whether or why agents improve. We introduce LatentGym: a controllable suite in which each environment is organized around a ground-truth latent variable governing the structure across tasks. Our construction yields metrics that separate exploration (whether the agent's actions gather information about the latent) from exploitation (whether the agent uses what it has gathered). We demonstrate our suite on empirical studies addressing three questions: how and why

translated_title: LatentGym：一个具有可控潜在结构的跨任务经验学习测试平台
translated_abstract: 我们设想持续学习的智能体系统能够随时间推移变得更有用：当它们遇到一系列相关任务时，应该推断出这些任务间共享的隐藏结构，并利用它来改进未来的决策。这种跨任务经验学习能力在个性化和交互式辅助等领域至关重要，但现有的训练/评估框架无法提供共享的、可控的潜在结构，也无法衡量智能体是否以及为何有所改进。我们提出了LatentGym：一个可控的测试套件，其中每个环境都围绕一个控制跨任务结构的真值潜在变量构建。我们的构造产生了能够区分探索（智能体的动作是否收集关于潜在变量的信息）与利用（智能体是否使用所收集的信息）的评估指标。我们通过实证研究展示了该套件，回答了三个问题：如何以及为什么……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出了LatentGym测试平台，通过围绕真值潜在变量构建可控环境，实现了对智能体跨任务经验学习能力的度量，并可将探索与利用行为分开评估。
en_tdlr: We introduce LatentGym, a controllable testbed built around ground-truth latent variables that measures whether and why agents improve in cross-task experiential learning, with metrics that separate exploration from exploitation.
